name: todo-api
title: Todo API — add a todo (Spring Boot)

pricing.description: Rate limits and field caps from ops

spec-md.description: The human prose of this spec — generated from this json

arch.description: Architecture diagram (mermaid): layers, request flow, where the todo parts sit

spec.why: A single user needs to track tasks. v1 delivers create; list and complete follow.

stories.want: to add a todo with a title

requirements.text: The API MUST accept POST /todos with {"title"} and MUST respond 201 with a Location header naming the new resource.

scenarios.then: 201, body echoes title + id, Location header present

scenarios.when: title is blank or over 200 chars
scenarios.then: 400 with a field error naming title

requirements.text: The API MUST return GET /todos as a JSON array, newest first.

constraints.text: title MUST be 1..200 characters after trim.
p95 create latency under 150 ms on the v1 profile.

clarifications.question: Postgres or an H2 file database for v1?
Do todos need a done flag in v1?

out_of_scope: list and complete endpoints (FR-2 is recorded, not this slice)

plan.approach: Plain layered Spring Boot: controller validates and shapes HTTP, service owns the 1..200 rule, repository persists via JPA. H2 file database behind Flyway so v1 runs from a checkout with zero setup. See DG-1 for the layers and DG-2 for the create-request flow.

diagrams.caption: Layers: controller → service → repository over H2; where each DES- part sits
Create-request sequence: validate → rule → persist → 201 + Location

designs.title: TodoController
designs.detail: Exposes POST /todos. Bean validation draws the 400 path; happy path returns 201 + Location built from the saved id.

designs.title: TodoService
designs.detail: Owns the create rule: trims, enforces 1..200, delegates persistence. The one place CON-1 lives.

designs.title: TodoRepository
designs.detail: JPA repository over TodoEntity; nothing but persistence.

designs.title: TodoEntity + Flyway V1
designs.detail: id UUID, title varchar(200), createdAt instant, done boolean (Q-2 pending). Migration V1__todos.sql.

decisions.decision: H2 file database for v1; Postgres deferred
decisions.because: Zero-setup checkout beats operational realism in a slice; schema is JPA-managed so the swap is a driver + URL.

decisions.decision: Validation at the controller with bean validation; domain rule re-checked in the service, duplicated nowhere else
decisions.because: 400 field errors are an HTTP concern; the service re-check keeps service tests honest.

tasks.title: TodoEntity + Flyway migration
tasks.detail: Entity per DES-4; migration creates the todos table.

verify.expect: exit 0 — migration applies on empty H2

tasks.title: TodoService.create() with the 1..200 rule
tasks.detail: create(title) trims, enforces CON-1, saves, returns the entity.

tasks.title: POST /todos controller with 201 + Location
tasks.detail: Bean validation for the 400 path (AC-2); 201 + Location for the happy path (AC-1).

verify.expect: exit 0 — AC-1 and AC-2 both pass

evidence.notes: FAIL: Location header missing — AC-1 unmet; fixing
